question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Drenched
solution:
The correct answer is **'Airy.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Drenched** means to be completely soaked or wet. **(पूरी तरह से गीला होना।)**

 
 
• **Example Sentence:** After the sudden downpour, I was absolutely drenched.
 
 
 
• Airy refers to having a lot of fresh air inside. In this context, it's the best antonym as it implies not being loaded or burdened with moisture. (हवादार।)
 
 
• **Example Sentence: **After hanging my clothes out to dry in the sun, they felt so airy and fresh.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fresh: **Not previously known or used; new or different. (पहले से ना जाना गया या प्रयोग किया गया; नया या अलग।)
 
• **Damp: **Slightly wet. (हल्का गीला।)
 
• **Lively: **Full of life and energy; active and outgoing. (जीवन और ऊर्जा से भरपूर; सक्रिय और आवगमन।)
